title: Callouts and tabs
description: Quarto callouts become admonitions, panel tabsets become content tabs.

## Callouts

::: {.callout-note}
A note without an explicit title.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Pro tip"}
Callouts can contain **Markdown**, `code` and lists:

- one
- two
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Heading as title
The heading becomes the admonition title.
:::

::: {.callout-caution collapse="true" title="Click to expand"}
Hidden until you open it.
:::

::: {.callout-important collapse="false" title="Open by default"}
Collapsible, but open initially.

::: {.callout-note title="Nested note"}
Callouts can be nested.
:::
:::

## Tabsets

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Python

```python
print("hello")
```

## R

```r
print("hello")
```

:::

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Output

``` {.python .cell-code}

```

```
45
```
:::
